_comment: Machine-readable map of the best headline results to the exact archived runs and parameters that produced them. Single source of truth for scripts/run_best.py (dry-run default), scripts/reproduce_best.sh (wrapper), and docs/BEST_RESULTS.md. Per-run accuracies are NOT copied here: they are read from each run's archived result.json at runtime so the manifest cannot drift from the evidence.

meta.corpus: BinKit x86_64, program-grouped split (47 test programs / 28 val programs). O2/O3 test = 55,657 windows; opt4 test = 116,321 windows.
meta.gpu: One NVIDIA H200 (141 GB), bf16 autocast

unit_notes.stride_512: Evaluation unit is the non-overlapping 512-byte window. A 2048-byte encoder input still reports accuracy at that 512-byte stride (overlapping windows).
unit_notes.aperture_16.9KB: 16.9 KB aperture = mean of the window and its 16 neighbours either side = radius 16 in scripts/combine.py --context.
unit_notes.val_seed: --val-seed pins the train/validation program partition. Early wide runs (r4, r6) omit it; the protocol was introduced before r7/r8/r9. Replaying an archived args.json keeps val_seed omitted when it is omitted.

mlm512.description: 512-byte MLM pre-training (paper §3.2). Init for every narrow run and the warm start for the 2048-byte continued pre-training.

mlm2048.description: 2048-byte MLM by continued pre-training from mlm512. From-scratch pre-training was rejected because it did not converge within the tested budget.

corpus.description: BinKit x86_64 corpus packed from .text sections; needed by every phase.

mlm512.description: 512-byte MLM pre-training. Exact args from reports/runs/best/mlm512/pretrain_args.json (replayed; fresh output only).

mlm2048.description: 2048-byte MLM by continued pre-training from mlm512. {corpus}, {mlm512}, and {mlm2048} are substituted by the runner.

o2o3_7wide_512B.description: 7-wide-run ensemble, O2/O3, scored at the 512-byte target stride (sequence level)
o2o3_7wide_512B.membership_evidence: Exact 7-member recipe: r4_ctx2048_dense (seed 1234) + r6_dense2048_seed{7,13,29} + r7_wide2048_seed{7,13,29}. All use a 2048-byte encoder at stride 512; r4/r6 start from the tiled 512-byte MLM and r7 starts from the continued 2048-byte MLM.

o2o3_7wide_16.9KB.description: Same 7-wide-run ensemble with a 16.9 KB inference aperture
o2o3_7wide_16.9KB.unit: sequence-level accuracy, mean over 33 neighbouring 512 B windows (radius 16)

o2o3_pretrained_wide_mean.description: Mean per-window accuracy of the 2048-byte PRETRAINED wide encoder on O2/O3, 3 seeds
o2o3_pretrained_wide_mean.unit: per-window accuracy at the 512 B metric (encoder input 2048 B)
o2o3_pretrained_wide_mean.note: Three seeds only (seed 1234 is NOT in this mean: r4/r6 start from the 512-byte MLM, not from mlm2048). Comparison control: pinned-partition 512-byte baseline mean 68.61% (r1_base + r8_base_pinned_seed{7,13,29}, archived only).

o2o3_19run_binary.unit: binary-level accuracy, majority vote over all windows per binary
o2o3_19run_binary.note: The archive reports 93.09%, but does not record the exact 19-member ensemble. Reproduction needs both the precise member list and their probabilities or checkpoints; the probability archive alone does not identify the original selection.

opt4_6run_16.9KB.description: 6-run ensemble (3 narrow + 3 wide) on the 4-way task with a 16.9 KB aperture
opt4_6run_16.9KB.unit: sequence-level accuracy, 4-class, mean over 33 neighbouring 512 B windows

also_reports.label: binary-level majority vote of the same 6 runs

opt4_3wide_binary.description: Binary-level vote over just the 3 wide opt4 runs
